meta.name: add-mattermost
meta.description: Add a self-hosted or cloud Mattermost bot channel through the Chat SDK bridge, reusing a local server when available and offering an evaluation server when none exists.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给 Mattermost 添加机器人频道,自动复用本地或评估服务器
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果团队用 Mattermost 需要快速接入机器人频道
copy.tagline_en: Add a Mattermost bot channel, auto-reusing local or evaluation server
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team uses Mattermost and needs to quickly add a bot channel

howto.what: Claude 会引导你接入 Mattermost 机器人频道：先探测可用的本地或云端服务器，配置 SiteURL、机器人令牌和回调地址，再复制并注册频道适配器。之后私聊、频道消息、线程和审批卡片可在 Mattermost 与 NanoClaw 之间互通。
howto.when: 当你要求添加 Mattermost 频道时，它会先探测本机或已有服务器（如 localhost:8065），再让你选择复用、手填 URL 或新建本地评估服务器；未获批准不会自动安装。

say.text: 帮我添加一个 Mattermost 频道。
say.note: 它会先探测本机现有的 Mattermost 服务器。

say.text: 新建一个本地 Mattermost 评估服务器。
say.note: 它会先说明要创建的 Docker 容器，等你确认。

howto.what_en: It adds a Mattermost bot channel: it discovers a local or cloud server, sets SiteURL, bot token and callback URL, then copies and registers the channel adapter, so DMs, threads and approval cards bridge Mattermost and NanoClaw.
howto.when_en: When you ask to add a Mattermost channel, it probes for an existing server (e.g. localhost:8065) and, with approval, reuses it, takes a URL you enter, or creates a local evaluation server.

say_en.text: Add a Mattermost channel for me.
say_en.note: It probes your local Mattermost server first.

say_en.text: Use https://mattermost.example.com as the Mattermost server.
say_en.note: That URL becomes the canonical base URL.

say_en.text: Create a local Mattermost evaluation server.
say_en.note: It explains the Docker containers first, then waits.
